chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah, from Abān, from Yaḥyā ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
If the slave kills the free man, then the family of the slain person have the choice: if they wish, they may kill him; and if they wish, they may enslave him.

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْمَقْتُولِ: the family or heirs of the slain person who hold the legal choice
key_terms.اسْتَعْبَدُوا: they may enslave; meaning to take the killer into servitude
key_terms.الْحُرَّ: the free person; the victim in this ruling
key_terms.الْعَبْدُ: the slave; the perpetrator in this ruling
key_terms.قَتَلُوا: they may kill; meaning to exact retaliatory execution

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a slave kills a free person in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding retaliation when a slave kills a free person. It establishes that the heirs of the slain person have authority to choose between execution and enslavement of the killer.
